name: FullContext
author: FullContext Team

sections.description:
FullContext allows you to create AI agent chatbots and power them using simple, natural language scripts. This plugin lets you easily embed the agent on your WordPress website.

Our agents can do many things, including:

📚 Give product demos – Show off interactive product tours, case studies, slide decks, videos and other docs to buyers directly in the chat experience.

💡 Qualify and proactively lead the conversation – Instead of just acting as a reactive question answerer, our agents can be instructed to proactively ask questions and steer the conversation in a particular direction.

🗓️ Schedule meetings – When appropriate, the agent can schedule meetings with the buyer using Calendly, HubSpot or our native meeting scheduler.

Check out the video below where co-founder Gordon walks through how to create a Book a Meeting script:

For more information, please visit www.fullcontext.ai.

External services

This plugin embeds a FullContext agent on your WordPress website to provide the visitor with an AI-powered chat experience.

When the user interacts with the agent, any messages they send in the chat interface are transmitted to the FullContext platform. The conversation is saved to your FullContext account.

The plugin does not embed the agent on admin pages, and on visitor pages it only adds the necessary JavaScript if the Agent ID has been configured properly in the plugin settings.

Depending on how you configure the agent on the FullContext website, the embedded script may send visitor information, such as IP address and the URL of the current page, to the FullContext API even if the visitor does not interact with the agent chat.

For more information, please visit the FullContext Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions.
